en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style image showing a large villa beside a small ornamental pond and garden. The house has a distinctive onion-shaped dome with a cross on top, timber-framed gables, and wraparound wooden balconies. Leafless trees suggest early spring or late autumn. In the left background, several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along a path. Another residential building stands farther back on the right, and low hills are faintly visible in the distance.
